defs.meaning: （探测光、热、压力等的）传感器，敏感元件，探测设备

examples.en: A sensor channels the light signal along an optical fibre.
examples.zh: 传感器沿光导纤维输送光信号。

examples.en: The electronic sensor has been adapted to fit on a newborn baby.
examples.zh: 电子传感器已被改装以适应新生儿。

examples.en: One of the designers said, "Now the ultrasonic sensor on the glove is quite large."
examples.zh: 其中一位设计师说：“现在手套上的超声波传感器相当大了。”
